article.story: VANCOUVER, British Columbia -- — Leevi Merilainen made 23 saves in his first start for Vancouver and the Canucks had a four-goal third period in a 4-1 victory over the Calgary Flames on Saturday night. Liam Ohgren celebrated his 100th NHL game by scoring a goal and assisting on defenseman Elias Pettersson’s winner. Drew O’Connor and Aatu Raty also scored, and defenseman Tom Willander and center Linus Karlsson each had two assists. Matt Coronato had a power-play goal for Calgary, and Devin Cooley made 22 saves. The Flames are 0-2. Pettersson made it 2-1 at 9:04 of the third period. He took a pass from Ohgren and lifted a backhander past Cooley’s glove. Up next Flames: At Seattle on Sunday night. Canucks: Host Vegas on Sunday night. ------ See AP’s full NHL coverage here
